title: endorse --from DRAFT
description: Settled (round 3): 'git vouch endorse --from DRAFT' signs a git-vouch-migrate endorsement draft after checking endorserKey matches the signing key and using the git-vouch-endorse namespace, mirroring 'register --from'. Also: no man page; check with no DIR keeps checking the synced copy (pass . for a checkout; add that to --help); default registry URL stays a ponytail placeholder until kernel.org names the repo; an sk-key generation block in the guides that needs a physical token is marked not-run and content-checked by the doc test; Scale numbers in DESIGN stay labelled 'at research time'.
acceptance_criteria: endorse --from tests: matching key signs; mismatched endorserKey refused; output passes check. --help mentions '.'.
